metaDescription: Order custom recycled lanyards for eco-friendly branding. Durable, made from recycled materials. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom recycled lanyards let you promote your brand while reducing environmental impact. Made from recycled plastic bottles, these lanyards offer the same durability and vibrant printing options as traditional materials. They are ideal for trade shows, employee IDs, and events where sustainability matters. Choose from recycled polyester weaves and customize with full-color sublimation or screen printing for a professional look that aligns with your green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom recycled lanyards with full-color print and metal clip, made from recycled materials
